title: 12 Best Food Markets in Cartagena
description: Discover Cartagena's vibrant food markets, from the bustling Bazurto to charming local stalls. Taste authentic Colombian street food, fresh seafood, exotic fruits, and traditional sweets. Your guide to the best culinary experiences.

places.name: Mercado de Bazurto
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Sancocho de Pescado (fish soup), Arepa de Huevo, and a tasting of various fresh exotic fruits.

places.name: Plaza de la Trinidad
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Arepas de queso (cheese arepas), Patacones con todo (fried plantain with toppings), and fresh-squeezed natural juices.

places.name: Mercado de Santa Rita
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Inexpensive meat cuts for cooking, fresh local fruits like mamón and nispero, and local cheeses.

places.name: Portal de los Dulces
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Cocadas (coconut macaroons), Caballitos (papaya preserves), Alegrías (amaranth and panela bars), and Tamarindos (tamarind candies).

places.name: Mercado de Marbella
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The freshest catch of the day (perfect for grilling), local root vegetables like yuca and ñame, and plantains.

places.name: Mercado de Manga
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Tropical fruits like mangoes, papayas, and guanabana, local cheeses, and freshly ground Colombian coffee.

places.name: Mercado de Crespo
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Freshly caught smaller fish, local aromatic herbs like cilantro and cebollín, and unique regional spices.

places.name: Street Food Vendors at Parque Centenario
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Refreshing ceviche served in a cup, various Arepas rellenas (stuffed arepas), and a cool Raspao (shaved ice) to beat the heat.

places.name: Street Food Vendors at Muelle de los Pegasos
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A fried fish platter with crispy patacones, seafood cocktails brimming with fresh ingredients, and grilled chicken or beef skewers.

places.name: Mercado Artesanal y Gastronómico de Getsemaní
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Handmade empanadas with unique fillings, local sweet breads, fresh tropical fruit juices, and artisanal coffee products.

places.name: Mercado de Olaya Herrera
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order An abundance of fresh fish for cooking, unusual tropical fruits you haven't seen before, and unique local spices and herbs.

places.name: Mercado de San Francisco (Olaya Herrera)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order An assortment of root vegetables like yuca and papa (potatoes), fresh herbs for cooking, and local snacks from smaller, independent vendors.
